title: BCI Competition 2020 Track 4 — Upper-limb grasping motor imagery
description: A preprocessed derivative EEG dataset from BCI Competition 2020 Track 4, containing motor imagery recordings of three right-arm grasping tasks (cylindrical, spherical, lumbrical) from 15 healthy participants across three sessions. It provides 60-channel EEG sampled at 250 Hz with 450 trials per subject, and is designed for evaluating session-to-session transfer learning in brain-computer interfaces. The data were re-formatted to BIDS via MOABB and hosted on NEMAR.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a BrainAmp system (60 channels, 250 Hz, referenced to FCz, ground Fpz) while subjects performed cue-based motor imagery of three grasping tasks in three sessions separated by 7 days. Each 10 s trial comprised 3 s rest, 3 s visual cue, and 4 s motor imagery. Data were notch filtered at 60 Hz and cue-aligned epoched, and the 4 s motor imagery window was extracted.
